query:
For a certain daytime and nighttime service bus route, the number of drivers and crew members required during each time period is given in 42.csv:

    Assuming that the drivers and crew members start working at the beginning of each time period and work continuously for 4 hours, how many drivers and crew members should be assigned to this bus route at least? Write down the linear programming model for this problem.
generated_model:
Let $x_t$ be the number of drivers and crew members who start working at the beginning of time period $t$ ($t = 1,2,\ldots,24$). Each person works for 4 consecutive hours (periods). The required number of drivers and crew members in each period is given by $r_t$.

Given data (from 42.csv, in source order):

\[
\begin{array}{|c|c|c|}
\hline
\text{Shift} & \text{Time} & r_t = \text{Number Required} \\
\hline
1 & 0:00-1:00 & 20 \\
2 & 1:00-2:00 & 18 \\
3 & 2:00-3:00 & 15 \\
4 & 3:00-4:00 & 15 \\
5 & 4:00-5:00 & 20 \\
6 & 5:00-6:00 & 30 \\
7 & 6:00-7:00 & 60 \\
8 & 7:00-8:00 & 70 \\
9 & 8:00-9:00 & 50 \\
10 & 9:00-10:00 & 55 \\
11 & 10:00-11:00 & 65 \\
12 & 11:00-12:00 & 75 \\
13 & 12:00-13:00 & 80 \\
14 & 13:00-14:00 & 70 \\
15 & 14:00-15:00 & 60 \\
16 & 15:00-16:00 & 55 \\
17 & 16:00-17:00 & 60 \\
18 & 17:00-18:00 & 75 \\
19 & 18:00-19:00 & 85 \\
20 & 19:00-20:00 & 70 \\
21 & 20:00-21:00 & 50 \\
22 & 21:00-22:00 & 40 \\
23 & 22:00-23:00 & 35 \\
24 & 23:00-0:00 & 25 \\
\hline
\end{array}
\]

Define $x_t \in \mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0}$ for $t=1,\ldots,24$.

Objective:
\[
\min \sum_{t=1}^{24} x_t
\]

Constraints:

For each time period $s = 1,2,\ldots,24$:
\[
\sum_{k=0}^{3} x_{((s-k-1) \bmod 24) + 1} \geq r_s
\]
where $x_{((s-k-1) \bmod 24) + 1}$ denotes the number of staff who started in the current or previous 3 periods (with wrap-around for the 24-hour schedule).

Explicitly, for each $s=1,\ldots,24$:
\[
x_s + x_{s-1} + x_{s-2} + x_{s-3} \geq r_s
\]
with indices taken modulo 24, i.e., $x_0 = x_{24}$, $x_{-1} = x_{23}$, $x_{-2} = x_{22}$.

Variable domains:
\[
x_t \in \mathbb{Z}_{\geq 0}, \quad t=1,\ldots,24
\]

All data and indices are preserved in source order.
